project_name: GREM - Solana-Native Crypto Intelligence ('The Wallet Goblin')

brand_identity.brand_persona: Crypto-native, internet-native, memeable, mysterious, intelligent, underground, slightly chaotic, modern.
brand_identity.visual_theme: Premium dark Web3 dashboard with 8-bit pixel-art elements, subtle CRT scanlines, glowing neon green accents, and clean modern typography. Must feel like a real high-performance crypto intelligence tool with deep meme-native soul.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

layout_and_grids.spacing_scale: Generous spacing philosophy: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16. Always ensure containers with borders have p-6 or p-8 internal padding to avoid text collisions.
layout_and_grids.bento_dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
layout_and_grids.table_to_cards: Mobile-first approach: Analytics tables must transform into horizontally swipeable or stacked cards on mobile views (< 768px).

visual_enhancers.scanlines: Subtle repeating linear gradient for CRT feel on specific containers (0.03 opacity overlay). Do NOT cover the entire viewport in heavy scanlines.
visual_enhancers.pixel_borders: Subtle 1px solid borders with 2px corner offset accent boxes in neon green or Solana purple.

Navbar.description: Sticky dark navbar with backdrop blur, 8-bit GREM logo badge, navigation links (Wallet, Token, Intelligence, Discovery, $GREM, Lore, About), wallet connect primary button with neon green border glow, and mobile hamburger menu.
Navbar.styles: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#070609]/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-3

Footer.description: Deep dark footer featuring massive 'THE WALLET GOBLIN' outlined display text, quick links, social channels (Twitter/X, Telegram, Pump.fun), live SOL price ticker, and copyright.

TokenCard.description: Displays token icon, symbol, name, live price, 24h gain/loss with green/red indicator, liquidity, market cap, and quick GREM risk badge.
TokenCard.styles: bg-[#13101C] border border-slate-800 hover:border-[#00FF66]/50 rounded-xl p-5 transition-all duration-200

WalletSummary.description: Header metric panel showing total portfolio value in USD & SOL, 24h change, token count, top allocation pie/bar, and trader behavior archetype tag.

RiskBadge.description: Semantic badge indicating risk level: Lower Risk (Green #00FF66), Warning Risk (Yellow #F59E0B), Critical Risk (Red #EF4444). Include pixel icon or warning sign.

MetricCard.description: Data widget showing single metric with clear title, large mono value, secondary trend percentage, and subtle background chart micro-sparkline.

IntelligenceCard.description: GREM's Take natural language summary component with 8-bit goblin avatar, typewriter effect or terminal styling, key detected trading patterns, and score index.

SearchInput.description: Solana address / token contract input with quick paste button, 8-bit search icon, neon green focus ring, and recent searches dropdown.

LoadingState.description: Animated 8-bit GREM goblin searching through CRT code monitor with glowing green progress bar and chaotic terminal text logs.

EmptyState.description: Pixel art GREM sleeping or holding magnifying glass with message 'No wallet or token selected. Enter a Solana address to begin watching.'

ErrorState.description: Pixel art GREM looking confused or holding broken cable with red alert glow and 'Invalid Solana address or RPC request failed' message.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, inputs, links, cards, tables) have explicit data-testid attributes.
Implement mobile-first responsive layout where tables collapse or scroll smoothly into card views on small viewports.
Maintain the dark, mysterious, crypto-native vibe with neon green primary accents and purple Solana highlights.
Incorporate the provided 8-bit GREM mascot images (/public/grem.jpg, /public/grem-hero.jpg, etc.) prominently across hero, loading, empty, and lore sections.
Use semantic risk colors consistently across Wallet Analyzer and Token Analyzer (Green = Lower Risk, Yellow = Warning, Red = Critical).
Never rely on default browser inputs or transparent header dropdowns.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast: Ensure normal text maintains 4.5:1 contrast and interactive elements stand out clearly against near-black surfaces.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.hover_states: Always explicitly define hover colors (e.g. hover:bg-[#00FF66] hover:text-[#070609] transition-colors).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.animations: Use framer-motion for smooth micro-interactions, modal reveals, and status badge pulses.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_ids: MUST add data-testid to every interactive component (e.g., data-testid='wallet-search-btn').
